routes.does: Landing page. It links to /sections, states a $0 service fee, and does not read or write intake data.
routes.verify: Open /. There is no unit test for this screen. bun run check does not boot Next.js. Disclaimer phrases are covered by apps/web/src/components/system/system.test.tsx.

routes.does: Short terms notice. It repeats that AOS is not a law firm and is not a substitute for the advice of an attorney, and it says a lawyer has not published a contract yet.
routes.reach: the Terms link in the site footer
routes.verify: Open /terms. The disclaimer phrases are asserted in apps/web/src/components/system/system.test.tsx.

routes.does: Privacy notes that are true today. Lines that depend on auth, encryption, or analytics changes stay out of the page.
routes.reach: the Privacy link in the site footer
routes.verify: bun run check runs apps/web/src/components/system/system.test.tsx, which asserts encryption and sign-in claims are hidden.

routes.does: Application overview made of static cards. Nothing on the page is loaded from Convex.
routes.reach: the home page link Start filling out my forms, or the URL
routes.verify: Open /sections and confirm the cards do not change after saving petitioner data. No automated test covers this page.

routes.does: Petitioner basics. React Hook Form validates petitionerBasicsSchema, writes a sessionStorage draft immediately, and debounces savePetitionerBasics to Convex once given name, family name, citizenship status, and relationship are filled in.
routes.verify: bun run check runs apps/web/src/app/lib/__tests__/petitionerBasicsSchema.test.ts. The preview flow is apps/web/e2e/review-package.spec.ts, which needs a Convex login and Playwright.

routes.does: Petitioner address history. AddressHistory saves on submit through saveAddress with personRole petitioner. Every saved row uses addressType physical, so the mailing-address branch in buildPdfPayload is unreachable from this screen.
routes.reach: Sidebar, Petitioner Information, Address History (5 years)
routes.verify: bun run check runs addressSchema.test.ts and addressValidation.test.ts. Browser coverage is apps/web/e2e/address-history.spec.ts, which needs Convex and Playwright.

routes.does: Petitioner employment history. EmploymentHistory persists rows to Convex, but both the save and the list query hardcode personRole petitioner. buildPdfPayload accepts the rows and does not write them into the PDF.
routes.reach: Sidebar, Petitioner Information, Employment History (5 years)
routes.verify: bun run check runs employmentSchema.test.ts. Nothing asserts the role or the PDF mapping. See docs/agent-patterns.md.

routes.does: Static beneficiary basics. There is no Convex table for this section and the form does not save.
routes.verify: Open /sections/beneficiary. The page module does not call useQuery or useMutation. No unit test covers the screen.

routes.does: Beneficiary address history. The same AddressHistory component as the petitioner page, with personRole beneficiary. Saved rows still use addressType physical.
routes.reach: Sidebar, Beneficiary Information, Address History (5 years)
routes.verify: The address schema and addressValidation tests in bun run check cover the form rules. The Playwright spec only opens the petitioner URL.

routes.does: Static beneficiary employment form. It does not use EmploymentHistory and does not save.
routes.reach: Sidebar, Beneficiary Information, Employment History (5 years)
routes.verify: Open /sections/beneficiary/employment. Inputs are uncontrolled placeholders. No unit test covers the screen.

routes.does: Static biographic details. There is no Convex table for biographic data.
routes.verify: Open /sections/beneficiary/biographic. No unit test covers the screen.

routes.does: Static marital history. There is no Convex table for marital data.
routes.verify: Open /sections/marital. No unit test covers the screen.

routes.does: Static forms index. The sidebar does not link here. The page tells the reader to pick a form that nothing routes to from the nav.
routes.verify: Open /forms. No unit test covers the screen.

routes.does: Static I-130 petitioner mock. The live petitioner form is /sections/petitioner. Next.js fails the production build on this URL when NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL is empty, because the shared layout calls useMutation.
routes.verify: Open the URL. No unit test covers the screen. Do not treat a successful next build as proof the form saves.

routes.does: Static I-130 beneficiary mock. The live beneficiary address form is /sections/beneficiary/address.
routes.verify: Open the URL. No unit test covers the screen.

routes.does: Static I-485 biographic mock. It does not save, and it no longer shows a hardcoded completion percent.
routes.verify: Open the URL. No unit test covers the screen.

routes.does: Liveness response {"ok": true}.
routes.reach: GET http://localhost:8000/health while the API is running
routes.verify: bun run check runs apps/api/tests/test_api.py::test_health_ok. The test uses FastAPI TestClient and does not bind a port.

routes.does: Lists AcroForm leaf fields for Forms/{slug}.pdf. Any filename in Forms/ is a slug. Only i-130 is used by the UI.
routes.verify: bun run check runs test_unknown_form_is_not_found. A real listing is GET /fields/i-130 against a running server, or the catalog apps/api/data/i-130.fields.csv.

routes.does: Dumps one field's /AP, /V, /AS, and parent. The name query must be URL-encoded, with brackets as %5B and %5D.
routes.verify: bun run check runs test_debug_field_requires_a_name. Inspect a live field only when the server is up.

routes.does: Fills Forms/{slug}.pdf from {fields, checkboxes} and streams the PDF back. Checkbox on-values are sniffed from /AP. /V and /AS are both set, and /NeedAppearances is set on the AcroForm.
routes.reach: the Verify & Preview button, or POST /fill/i-130
routes.verify: bun run check runs uv run python scripts/eval_fill.py fixtures/ from apps/api. That command exits 1 when a fixture field or appearance state does not match.

flows.does: DashboardLayout builds an I-130 payload from Convex basics, addresses, and employment, prefers the sessionStorage basics draft, POSTs /fill/i-130, and shows the PDF in an iframe. Employment is passed in and then ignored. The header no longer shows a hardcoded percent.
flows.reach: the Preview my forms button in the app header, on any /sections or /forms page
flows.verify: apps/web/e2e/review-package.spec.ts drives the button with a mocked /fill/i-130 response. It needs Convex and Playwright, so it is not part of bun run check. Fill accuracy without the browser is eval_fill.py.

flows.does: Development-only header button. It builds the fixture from saved Convex records, not the unsaved sessionStorage draft, downloads {payload, expected_values}, and copies expected_values from text fields only.
flows.reach: the Export Fixture button in the header when NODE_ENV is development
flows.verify: No unit test covers the button. The downloaded shape is what eval_fill.py accepts. Confirm against apps/api/scripts/eval_fill.py _load_fixture.
